verdict.rationale: Bugbot runs reviews when a PR is updated or when someone comments `bugbot run`. Those are event-driven and one-off manual triggers, not a recurring time-based schedule. The 'Bugbot Automations' page is documented only for creating organization-wide rules, and the pack shows no cron, scheduled-job or recurring-workflow capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
